data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"15% of 80 equals 12, derived via structural decomposition into 10% and 5% components.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The distributive property of multiplication over addition does not hold.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The base quantity is not exactly 80, or the percentage is not exactly 15.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The covering principle is the distributive property of multiplication over addition: a * (b + c) = a*b + a*c. 15% decomposes to 10% + 5%. 10% of 80 is 8 (a base-10 shift). 5% is exactly half of 10%, so 5% of 80 is 4. 8 + 4 = 12.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
